text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading toward a ramen shop to grab a meal,
I caught sight of some familiar horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Spe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll put my whole heart into it and ganbaru!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Just stay focused, focus is key!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Focus, right! ...Hnunnn!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, here I go!
Please watch me dash through with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It is finally about to begin!
The 65th 'Big Eater Derby'!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Who will be the first to completely finish
all 24 dishes of our shop's ramen varieties?!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the distant glory, the 'Big Eater Derby'
...is officially underway!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Here I gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you rush too fast, fullness will strike at once, desu wa!
Please pace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Keep a close eye on the suckers around ya too!
If you stick to the mid-pack, you can easily pull off a late surge!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Looking good, looking good! Let's patiently aim from this pace!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, the Big Eater Derby
finally entered its climax.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *munch* *munch* *gobble* *gobble*...!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, Special Week is intently watching her opponent
leading ahead from behind!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The slope is conquered. All that's left is the last spurt.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's all cheer with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Spe, GO GET 'EEEM~~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Spe-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
UOOOOOHHH~~!!
*chomp* *chomp* *slurp* *slurp*!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Special Week initiates a sudden spurt right here!
She's closing in on her opponent ahead... She won't match pace, she won't even draw level!
She breezes past them in an instant~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aim for number one in Japannn~~!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Special Week finishes all bowls in first place~~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, thank you all so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When I first heard about that dream,
I was frankly bewildered about how to react, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Special Week-san,
you seem rather down lately, desu wa.
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Uuu, actually I haven't been able to lose weight as planned,
so it looks like I have no choice but to give up on entering the race...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So your condition adjustments haven't gone smoothly.
What race were you hoping to enter, desu no?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The 'Big Eater Derby'...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the Derby,
it is the grand stage of dreams that all horse girls aspire to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Big eater?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It was a contest I had given up on entering once,
but everyone told me they'd support me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And since you offered to accompany me on my diet,
I was able to take the plunge and take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's the same for real races too, isn't it...? When running toward your dreams, it's never just by your own strength alone...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's because everyone around is there supporting Rice that Rice can run with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is precisely right, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Alright! Toward cutting weight and my dream of being number one in Japan, I'll give it my all starting tomorrow too, desu!
